resolvedFindings.observedBeforeCorrection: Three high-alpha pixels at y511,x257..261 belong to the Terminus helmet. The former Vindicator source region ended at y512 and included them; the former Terminus region began at y512 and omitted the first line.
resolvedFindings.status: resolved in metadata before final verdict
resolvedFindings.resolution: Vindicator ends before the helmet pixels; Terminus begins above them and still reaches the original image bottom. No pixels or original generated files were edited.

comparisons.observation: Both show a six-wheel rover with a roof cannon and pale/red military body. The generated view is a clean isolated interpretation, not a reconstruction of the terrain screenshot or hidden chassis.

Both show the Normandy SR-1 context, a pale streamlined forward hull with red accent and swept angular structures beneath/behind. The generated single perspective supports recognition; fine hull geometry is not verified.

The labelled M-15 Vindicator V screenshot and generated rifle share broad red/gray profile, open rear stock, raised angular top section and pistol grip. The image does not implement rank V or certify muzzle/receiver detail.

primaryComparisonEvidence.qualification: These comparisons support a bounded visual identity, not exact geometry, palette, hidden views, original statistics or a global primary-verified flag.

renderingRequirementsForSubsequentUiQa: Use every exact sourceRect, including the six irregular equipment regions; do not infer a uniform 512px grid for equipment.
Clip explicitly to the declared source region inside the SVG/render viewport so letterboxing cannot reveal adjacent atlas cells.
Keep work/period and exact record identity gating. Aria ME2 and Traynor ME3 remain documentary portraits, not new squad members.
Verify actual desktop and mobile layout separately; this source-atlas review does not prove either UI rendering.
limitations: All 24art entries remain generated partial prototypes with primaryVisualVerified:false.
The remaining 21 entries, including the original mod-family schematics, have no newly qualified primary-model comparison in this review.
Broad recognizability is not a certified likeness, correct costume variant, anatomical mesh, manufacturer, weapon model geometry or 1:1 reproduction.
Bustes are intentionally cut at the torso; one fixed whole-body enemy/armor image does not deliver walking, eight directions, a firing cycle or equipment swaps.
Praetorian flight/barriers, Kai Leng phases/duel and Banshee powers are not implemented by their illustration.
Vehicle and ship illustrations do not add driving, flight, combat, upgrades, interiors or 3D geometry.

Native soft contours and halos remain. All four atlases have alpha maximum 254 and no fully opaque pixel; people atlas lower corners retain alpha 2. UI blending is not certified from source images alone.
The small official source figures leave fine geometry and alternate views unresolved.
No existing app, pixel, catalogue, historical report or Git commit was modified by this review.
